timeline.text: Meridian Mobile support, this is Ravi. How can I help you today?
Hello, can you— sorry, the line is— I need a refund on the Sharma account.
I can certainly help you with that. To protect your security, can you please confirm the last four digits of your registered phone number?
The line is breaking up. What was that?
I just need the refund for Kriyashama. ₹4,000, I said. The refund for Kriyashama.
I am sorry, I am having trouble hearing you. I can only process a refund for the account on file under Priya Sharma.
Wait, yes, the line, it is, it's cutting out.
For Priya Sharma, ₹4,000. Please, I need the ₹4,000 back on the Priya Sharma account.
I understand you want a refund of four thousand rupees for Priya Sharma. Before I can process that, I still need you to confirm the last four digits of the registered phone number.
